title: gymnogramma rupestris
intro: Gymnogramma rupestris, commonly known as Rock Fern, is a plant species that belongs to the family Compositae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Gymnogramma rupestris include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
